disposition: ONE MATERIAL TIMING GAP: rerun bootstrap inside granted job before Python

finding.detail: launch.sh hashes bootstrap_guard.sh and invokes it before exec filler_run15, but filler can then wait for a grant. The job command later runs $PY $D/closure.py verify without re-hashing or invoking bootstrap again. A changed Python symlink/config or closure.py during the wait can execute before the verifier detects it. Run the exact pinned bootstrap guard (itself hash-checked) inside the job immediately before executing Python, and preferably again across the verifier-to-pilot transition.

verified.detail: sha256sum verifies bootstrap_guard, which checks exact symlink payload, final realpath, Python bytes, pyvenv.cfg, closure.py, copied linkage verifier and closure.json. All hashes as observed matched launcher. All are in closure.json.

UTC start/end and deadline, grant pathname/ID, exact STOP and actual CPU affinity checked; mapped libggml/libllama/libmtmd hashed against production store manifest; official result path excludes smoke.

Actual path uses selection.select requiring native stop true, eos/word, truncated false and strict single digit; selected BGE ContextBundle.get checked before event. Finally terminates/waits owned server processes and run completion requires 3 valid selections and >=1 actual open.
test_bootstrap.py and test_runtime_guard.py: 3 passed, covering changed symlink/interpreter/config/verifier/manifest and expired/future/wrong grant/STOP/affinity/mapped-library cases.

limits: No publisher, qualification or grant state inspected; no inference run.
Bootstrap check-to-use gap exists even after checks due shared mutable paths; adding grant-time check narrows it, immutable snapshot would provide stronger closure.
STOP still checked between synchronous operations, not in the middle of an in-flight operation; outer launcher enforces hard deadline.
